description: Continue a failed background product bulk job from the batch it stopped at. Only a job whose `resumable` is true can be resumed - one that stopped on stalled, enqueueFailed or unexpected; a cancelled job or one that lost its model or patch cannot. Batches already applied are not repeated. A resumed delete job goes on deleting products permanently. Refused when another job is queued or running on the model. Needs the permission that starts a job of that kind (models:delete for a delete job, models:edit for an update job). Follow it with get_product_bulk_job.

jobId.description: The id of a failed job whose `resumable` is true (from get_product_bulk_job)

name: resume_product_bulk_job
title: Resume product bulk job
